scholarships.title: APU International Students Scholarships & Merit Awards 2026

existing.description: Asia Pacific University Malaysia offers international students tuition fee awards described as Merit Awards, which are fee awards leading to rebates or discounts. The published 2026/2027 table sets a 30% discount for AAA A-Levels, 8-9 O-Levels/IGCSE grades or IB Diploma 34 points and above, 20% for AAB, 6-7 O-Levels or IB 30-33 points, and 10% for ABB/AAC, 4-5 O-Levels or IB 26-29 points, with equivalent bands for IB MYP. The scheme applies to all nationalities, is awarded first come first served, and is renewable each year provided the student maintains a minimum CGPA of 2.50. The page publishes an application deadline heading but no date, so awards are treated as rolling.
eligibility: Any nationality ("applicable to all countries / nationalities")
Qualifying pre-university results: A-Levels, O-Levels/IGCSE, IB Diploma or IB MYP
Applicants with sports excellence at international events may be considered case by case
existing.eligibility_summary: New international students of any nationality admitted on the basis of A-Levels, O-Levels/IGCSE, IB Diploma or IB MYP results, which determine the size of the fee award.
benefits: 10%, 20% or 30% tuition fee discount according to qualification score
Renewal each academic year on meeting minimum CGPA 2.50
coverage: 10% to 30% tuition fee rebate/discount depending on qualification score
requirements: Awards are given on a first come first served basis
Renewal requires a minimum CGPA of 2.50 at the end of each academic year
Applications with incomplete or missing information and documents are not considered
documents: Completed APU International Students Scholarships & Merit Awards online application form
Evidence of the qualifying pre-university results
application_method: Complete the APU International Students Scholarships & Merit Awards online application form on the awards page
existing.selection_notes: The award level is determined by pre-university qualification scores; sports excellence at international events is assessed case by case. Awards are allocated first come first served.
existing.best_fit: International applicants who already hold strong A-Levels, O-Levels/IGCSE or IB results and are applying to an APU undergraduate programme.
existing.duration: Annual award, renewable each academic year while minimum CGPA 2.50 is maintained
existing.application_period: Open continuously on a first-come first-served basis; the page carries an "Application Deadline" heading but publishes no date.
existing.program_type: University merit scholarship / tuition fee award
